name: 2.0.0-test-rc16 focused checklist
description: Focused checks for automatic model suggestions during agent creation and editing, explicit application, responsive presentation, and release health.

items.name: AI-created agent gets a model suggestion
items.description: Test: Open Agents > Add Agent > AI Create. Describe a specific role with its work, tools, and output, choose Balanced, and generate. Pass: A runtime-available model is suggested, confidence, reasons, alternatives, and assumptions are visible, the suggested model is selected in the draft, and another available model can still be chosen before creation.

items.name: Quality, Balanced, and Cost change ranking
items.description: Test: Use an agent description that involves frequent structured classification. Generate once with Cost, then start over and generate with Quality using the same text. Pass: The selected priority is clear, both results contain only models available to this runtime, an efficient model is favored for Cost when available, and the explanation never claims measured price or quality.

items.name: Existing agent suggestion follows its instructions
items.description: Test: Open an existing agent's Actions > Edit. Wait for the automatic suggestion, then add a clear coding, vision, privacy, or tool requirement to its identity or tools text. Pass: The suggestion refreshes after the edit, shows alternatives and unknown capability warnings, and long model names remain readable.

items.name: Suggestion never silently changes an agent
items.description: Test: In Edit Agent Config, note the current model, choose Use suggestion or an alternative, then cancel and reopen. Repeat, save, and reopen again. Pass: Cancel preserves the original model, selecting a suggestion only changes the draft, Save applies the chosen model, and the runtime still reports it as supported.

items.name: RC16 identity, mobile layout, and restart
items.description: Test: Start the exact RC16 image, open Add Agent and Edit Agent Config on desktop and a phone-sized screen, switch model priorities, then restart. Pass: Dashboard and /api/system report 2.0.0-test-rc16, health is HTTP 200, controls wrap without horizontal scrolling, Save and Cancel stay reachable, workspace state survives restart, and intended plugins still load.
